1. The evidence shows there is a "Hubble tension" - different methods give different values:
   - Direct/local observations: around 73 km/s/Mpc (with 1% uncertainty according to one source)
   - Early universe/CMB/Planck: around 67-67.5 km/s/Mpc
   - Some newer measurements: 67.24 (2025), 70.39 (Freedman 2025), 73.50 (2026 H0DN Collaboration)

- One major class of measurements (late universe, distance ladder) does converge on approximately 73 km/s/Mpc
- However, another major class (early universe, CMB) gives around 67 km/s/Mpc
- There is significant tension/disagreement between methods
- Some recent measurements give intermediate values like 70.39
